meta.name: Store with a backlog, deterministic benchmark
meta.description: Spec 2 benchmark store with a backlog (#72): one arrival every 6 min from 0 into a store of initial 15 with reorder_point 5, order_quantity 10 and a constant lead time of 63 min, then a sink. The inventory position is stock on hand plus on order minus the items waiting for stock, reviewed at every demand: an order every 10 demands (60 min), each arriving 63 min later, after five items have waited.
